---
title: "Home runs"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hr_by_season <- Teams |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_G = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    hr_per_game = total_HR / total_G,
    season_type = if_else(yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020), "Shortened", "Full")
  )
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = hr_per_game)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgray") +
  geom_point(aes(color = season_type)) +
  labs(
    title = "Home Runs per Game in Major League Baseball by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home Runs per Game",
    color = "Season Type",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Teams |>
  filter(yearID %in% c(1981, 1994, 2019, 2020)) |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_G = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  mutate(hr_per_game = total_HR / total_G)
```
